verdict.rationale: Spline's first-party docs say it is "multiplayer from the ground up": files live in the cloud, several people can edit the same file at once, and both editors share "the same real-time collaboration" with in-place feedback. This delivers the core of simultaneous team editing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live cursors/presence indicators, documentation of sync behavior or latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time co-editing.
